scientific_integrity: The CDF, expectation, median, monotonicity and asymptotics are derived for the explicitly stated single-trait Gaussian architecture and two-dimensional positive-definite environment. They do not demonstrate empirical survival prediction, finite-sample predictive accuracy, or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Two environmental coordinates and one latent adaptive trait only.
Requires independent centered Gaussian allelic effects, positive-definite GEA and environment covariance, and absent direct environmental effects.
Probability is conditional on GEA coefficients and averages over hypothetical genetic architectures; observed fitness variation is excluded.
An unindexed mathematically equivalent Gaussian angular-law result remains possible; a related generalized-selection article was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Exact reliability law for two-dimensional genomic offset with one latent trait
